Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline

Class AcousticLiftCheckValve

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.AcousticLiftCheckValve
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class AcousticLiftCheckValve extends Object implements Serializable
Ideal translating, equal-pressure-area check valve for single-liquid acoustic screening.

Pressure work is reciprocal: total through-flow is signed orifice flow plus effective area times lift velocity. This is not a swing-disc, hydrodynamic flow-force, added-mass, rebound or cavitation model. Parameters must be independently justified for an actual valve. Backward Euler uses the previous accepted lift for orifice area. Perfectly inelastic contact is localized on the discrete implicit trajectory, not an exact continuous trajectory.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

    • AcousticLiftCheckValve

      public AcousticLiftCheckValve(double mass, double damping, double stiffness, double preload, double pressureArea, double dischargeCoefficient, double width, double maximumLift, double initialLift, String provenance)
      Construct immutable SI parameters; the initial velocity is zero.
      Parameters:
      mass - effective mass, positive kg
      damping - damping, nonnegative N s/m
      stiffness - stiffness, nonnegative N/m
      preload - closing preload, nonnegative N
      pressureArea - equal pressure/swept area, positive m2
      dischargeCoefficient - positive coefficient at most one
      width - orifice area per lift, positive m
      maximumLift - positive upper stop, m
      initialLift - initial lift between seat and upper stop, m
      provenance - nonempty source/applicability declaration
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for nonfinite or nonphysical parameters

    • step

      AcousticLiftCheckValve.Step step(double drive, double resistance, double density, double lift, double velocity, double duration)
      Find an admissible implicit interval, shortening at the first detected discrete bound crossing. The accepted numerical path has constant endpoint velocity over each interval; grazing continuous motion needs refinement and is not claimed to be event-exact.
      Parameters:
      drive - incoming characteristic minus receiver, Pa
      resistance - acoustic impedance, Pa s/m3
      density - liquid density, kg/m3
      lift - previous accepted lift, m
      velocity - previous accepted velocity, m/s
      duration - maximum interval, s
      Returns:
      tentative state and work; no external state is changed
